summary: Verified iteration-17 Portfolio load-perf optimization (frontend-only). All acceptance criteria pass on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). Legacy full-page red spinner (data-testid='portfolio-loading') is gone; data-testid='portfolio-root' + Navbar render immediately after JS eval (~890ms after commit on desktop, ~500ms after commit on mobile). Hero (data-testid='hero-typing') visible at ~3199ms desktop (target <4000ms) and ~1691ms mobile (target <3000ms). All 12 tracked APIs (/profile /sections /seo /skills /projects /certificates /education /social-links /testimonials /experience /counters /resume) fire within a 3ms spread — fully parallel, no sequential chain. CLS (buffered PerformanceObserver layout-shift) = 0.0032 (target <0.1). Zero uncaught JS errors or React Suspense warnings during initial load and first 5s, on both desktop and mobile. Regression: hireme-section, contact-section, resume-section, coding-profiles-section, github-activity-section all render with real data after hydration; document.title = 'Abhinandan Kumar — Software Engineer' and meta[name=description] populated (139 chars) from /api/seo. Code-splitting confirmed: 7 separate lazy chunks loaded (CustomCursor, LiveInfo, CodingProfiles, FloatingButtons, Journey, TechStack, GitHubActivity). GitHubActivity chunk starts downloading at ~2774ms — well after portfolio-root paints at ~892ms, so initial paint is not blocked on it. Skeleton visibility under API-delay (1200ms per list) confirmed: 6 skeleton-* elements visible ~400ms after root (kinds: grid-4×2, grid-3×2, timeline×2), all replaced within 2.5s as individual APIs resolved (progressive, not all-at-once). Mobile has no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==innerWidth==390). Admin regression smoke (smmramhelp@gmail.com / Admin@123) passes — /admin dashboard loads normally with Overview cards and Recent Activity feed.
action_items: MINOR (optional polish): The 4 lazy-loaded sections gated on list data (TechStack, CodingProfiles, GitHubActivity, Journey) render NOTHING during the data-loading phase because the Portfolio JSX pattern `<Suspense fallback={<SectionSkeleton/>}>{data.skills !== null && <TechStack.../>}</Suspense>` short-circuits the Suspense children to `false` while data.skills===null — so the Suspense fallback never triggers for the loading-data window; it only triggers for the chunk-download window. Net effect: at ~400ms into load we see 6 skeletons instead of the requested >=8. Not a functional regression (all real data hydrates correctly, no layout shift), but if the reviewer's >=8-skeleton bar is strict, wrap each of those 4 sections' loading state in a plain `data.<slice> === null ? <SectionSkeleton kind=... /> : (<Suspense fallback={<SectionSkeleton/>}><Lazy .../></Suspense>)` conditional so the skeleton is visible during both the API-loading AND the chunk-download phase.
critical_code_review_comments: Portfolio.jsx Stage-1/Stage-2 split is clean and the `alive` flag correctly cancels stale setState after unmount.
Every list state initializes to null (not []), so `withSkeleton(list, kind, node)` correctly differentiates 'still loading' from 'loaded but empty'. Good.
SectionSkeleton.jsx is small (63 lines), pure, and uses .skeleton pulse class from index.css. data-testid='skeleton-<kind>' is present for testability.
Suspense fallbacks are used properly — no React warnings emitted. All 7 heavy components code-split successfully (verified 7 separate .chunk.js files in resource timing).
See action_items[0] for the one nit: gating `{data.slice !== null && <Lazy/>}` inside Suspense hides both the fallback AND any custom loading state during API load — consider a two-tier fallback.
seed_data_creation: None. Read-only verification of public portfolio + admin login smoke.
